correctness.rationale: Reconstructed each parametric map and the iff cross-transversal criterion: equal-rank isotone transformations are semigroup inverses exactly when their ordered images hit corresponding blocks of the other kernel. For rank two the three cases (cut a, image b<c) pair a<b<c with (c-1;a,b) and b<c<=a with (b;c,a+1), fixing b<=a<c. For rank n-1 the unique adjacent double kernel block a and omitted image b pair b<a with (b;a+1), and b>a+1 with (b-1;a), fixing b=a,a+1. These piecewise maps satisfy the two sandwich equations, invert themselves and fix exactly idempotents. Counts follow: fixed binom(n+1,3), swaps binom(n,3), respectively 2(n-1) and binom(n-1,2); n=3 overlapping classes checked. Reimplemented exact composition and exhausted all parameter tuples independently n=3..8; proof covers all n.
